text:
tayler: incident-bot just paged me for high 5xx rate on /v1/generate, looks like increased errors since 14:02 PDT :alarm_clock:
incident-bot: [ALERT] high-error-rate service=inference route=/v1/generate window=5m error_rate=18% threshold=5% links=[ops.runbook/infra-5xx]
marta: I'm taking lead on this. oncall is devon today, @devon can you confirm you're in?
devon: here, oncall. jumping in. initial check: control plane healthy, but proxy pool 3 showing >70% connection resets.
devon: running quick tail on proxy logs now:
devon: ```
kubectl logs -n inference svc/proxy -l pool=pool-3 --since=10m | grep -i "reset" | wc -l
# outputs ~420 resets in last 10m
```
tayler: thanks. will notify CS for customer impact triage. @katie please ping the highest-traffic customers we track for SLOs.
katie: on it. sending note to top-10 customers with possible degraded responses, ETA 10m.
incident-bot: Escalation: paging escalation policy -> oncall->sre-lead at 14:12
marta: quick mitigation idea: drain pool-3 and shift traffic to pool-1/2 while we investigate kernel/driver issues. I'll start a canary drain.
devon: +1. issuing graceful drain now:
devon: ```
redwoodctl pool drain pool-3 --grace-period=30s --route-shift=50%
```
incident-bot: Action taken: pool-3 draining, route shift started. expected completion 14:17
tayler: CS update: katie reported 7 customers replied, two saw timeouts >10s, none reported data loss, all responses eventually arrived. severity looks degraded latency + increased errors for short window.
marta: logs show a surge of TLS handshake fails from a single infra host in pool-3. hitting kernel TLS bug? collecting core dumps.
devon: isolating host, provisioning replacement node. tagging for postmortem. node=infra-03, repro steps captured.
katie: updated customers with status: mitigation in progress, we will update after full remediation, offered status page updates. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: root thread created for post-incident review: thread_ts=1768302400
tayler: good. once cluster stable, we need an incident timeline, list of affected customers, and the credit calc inputs for finance. @samir can you prep the billing template?
samir: yep. I need: start/end of impact per customer, error-rate windows, and committed SLA terms. can you attach the timeline and customers list to the billing ticket?
marta: attaching preliminary timeline here (short):
- 14:02 alert: error rate spike detected
- 14:08 pool-3 drain started
- 14:17 traffic fully shifted, errors down to 1.2%
- 14:25 infra-03 isolated, replacement up
- 14:42 full traffic restored to pools 1/2/4
- 14:50 monitoring stable, incident declared resolved at 14:50
devon: root cause: suspected kernel TLS bug on infra-03 causing handshake resets under high connection churn. remediation: OS/kernel upgrade + repro guardrails + pool monitoring alert tuning.
tayler: OK. let's get a postmortem scheduled. options tomorrow 10:00 or 16:00 PT. which works?
marta: I can do 10:00. devon?
devon: 10:00 works. katie and samir?
katie: 10:00 good.
samir: I'm good at 10. please cc finance-bot when draft is ready so we can open billing adjustments.
finance-bot: Billing ticket created: BILL-3241. Please include CSV of affected accounts and minutes of downtime per account.
tayler: action items from this thread (assignments inline):
- marta: collect full logs + core dumps from infra-03 and prepare RCA draft (due EOD tomorrow).
- devon: schedule kernel/os upgrade for infra-03 fleet, add automated repro harness for TLS churn (due 1 week).
- katie: customer comms follow-up and SLO impact confirmations (due EOD today).
- samir: prepare SLA credit worksheet and liaise with finance (start now, update after PM).
- tayler: coordinate postmortem meeting and ensure on-call handoff notes included.
- finance-bot: attach BILL-3241 to internal billing queue and wait for CSV.
marta: noted. I'll also add a follow-up to the rollout checklist to tighten pool draining thresholds.
devon: added a temporary alert to detect single-host TLS error spikes and to auto-evacuate host from pool (will be reverted after fix).
samir: for the SLA credit calc I'll need: (1) committed monthly uptime for each affected customer, (2) minutes of reduced availability, (3) per-contract credit rules. I'll draft template in BILL-3241 and tag legal if needed.
katie: CS asked about timeline for credits if applicable—can finance estimate lead time?
samir: typical process: review + approval ~3 business days after we submit full incident packet; processing of credits on next billing cycle unless expedited. I'll flag when packet is attached.
tayler: postmortem meeting invite sent for 10:00 PT tomorrow, calendar link in thread. please RSVP. agenda: timeline, RCA, customer impact, remediation plan, credit decision inputs.
incident-bot: Reminder: mark incident severity and attach runbook link in postmortem doc.
marta: bumping for attachments: I'll upload logs + crash dumps to the postmortem doc now.
finance-bot: BILL-3241 updated: awaiting CSV attachment.
samir: once I get CSV I'll populate credit estimates and post to this thread + billing ticket.
tayler: thanks team. after PM we'll publish a short incident summary for customers and include any credit info for impacted accounts. keep updates here if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
